entry.name: mc.clip~
entry.description: Use the clip~ to constrain input signals between two specified values.

arguments.name: minimum
arguments.description: Initial minimum limit for the range of the output signal. If no argument is supplied, the minimum limit is initially set to. If a signal is connected to the middle inlet, the corresponding argument is ignored.

arguments.name: maximum
arguments.description: Initial maximum limit for the range of the output signal. If no argument is supplied, the maximum limit is initially set to. If a signal is connected to the middle inlet, the corresponding argument is ignored.
